name: hevc-eos-open-5380ca22-linux-arm64
reason: The subtitle-cc open case hevc-eos-ts in its four variants, on a c8g.2xlarge (Linux AArch64): folds of the pinned FFmpeg subtitles reference worker and of subtitle-worker, which differ in every variant because the caption extractor has no model of the decoder's picture output at a new sequence. A zstd-compressed tar of the deterministic pack.
